title: Lake Tahoe Clear Kayak Tour at Sand Harbor with Small Groups
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Embark on an unforgettable adventure as you explore the clear, vibrant waters of Lake Tahoe in a fully transparent kayak.
Glide over colorful rock formations, schools of fish, and shimmering sandbars, all visible through your kayak's crystal-clear base.

Choose from morning, midday, or sunset tours for a completely different vibe each time.
Our experienced guides lead you along the most scenic parts of the lake, sharing fun facts about Tahoe’s history, ecology, and hidden gems along the shoreline.

This one-of-a-kind experience is perfect for families, couples, solo travelers, and photographers looking for an epic and unique view of Lake Tahoe’s natural beauty.

No previous kayaking experience needed — we’ll provide all the training and safety gear you need for a fun, worry-free day on the water!

Please be advised that weight limits on a single kayak are 250 lbs and a tandem is 375 lbs.
